gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all screen schemes to understand how screens are organized in my Jira projects.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all screen schemes with their details, including IDs, names, and associated screens.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new screen scheme to customize the screens used in my projects.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the new screen scheme details and return the created screen scheme with its ID.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to delete an existing screen scheme that is no longer needed to keep the system clean.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the specified screen scheme and return a success message.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update an existing screen scheme to modify the screens associated with it.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the updated screen scheme details and return the updated screen scheme.
